exposure: Maternal dengue virus (DENV) infection/viremia during the peripartum period
outcome: DENV viral kinetics in maternal serum and breast milk
DENV viral kinetics in newborn serum and gastric fluid
Clinical presentation and biological evolution in mother-newborn pairs
cohort: Ten mother-newborn pairs in New Caledonia where mothers were hospitalized with dengue symptoms around delivery or whose infant was infected during breastfeeding.
finding: The occurrence of vertical DENV transmission was high (90%) in viremic mothers at delivery, and these mothers and their infants were at major risk for obstetric and neonatal complications.
